releases.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria
releases.summary: Is the next card going to be higher or lower? Do you have what it takes to beat the odds?See if you can beat your best score or your friends. Great at parties or if you have a few minutes and want to pass the time.Get stuck in to the best Higher or Lower game going!

releases.name: skl survivor
releases.summary: score attack game where you move forward and shoot continuously and must rotate change direction

releases.name: Dub Party
releases.summary: A dubbing party game for you and your friends. Import a video clip, claim the roles and record every line in the booth, then watch the finished dub together and save it. Play solo, pass one mic around on the couch, or invite up to 7 friends online.

releases.name: King in the Mountain
releases.summary: A calm strategic incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall between expeditions. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

releases.name: Zero To South
releases.summary: After the Y2K crash, take your taxi on the long road from Camp Zero to South. Pick up passengers, trade items, and survive the journey.

releases.name: Voltswarm
releases.summary: A lone robot faces an ever-growing machine swarm in this 3D bullet heaven. Weapons fire automatically. Choose your weapons, upgrades, cores, and mods wisely, then survive escalating waves of industrial chaos.

releases.name: Legacybound
releases.summary: You are on a Ninja and you need to jump over the obstacles.  How far can you run? FEATURES ? Beautiful Graphics ? Fun Obstacles ? Earn Different Characters ? Game

releases.name: PITH
releases.summary: Traverse a wonderful and strange world of cubes shrouded in fog in PITH, a 3D metroidvania adventure. Find tools to help delve deeper and uncover secrets that were hiding in plain sight.

releases.name: Feedmaster
releases.summary: Feedmaster is a strategy game about recommendations. Study users’ interests and emotions, turn creators, ads, and ideas into posts they’ll like, then combine users, tags, and traits to meet rising weekly goals and convert clicks. Where users—and the world—end up is something to worry about later.

releases.name: Box Flow
releases.summary: Box Flow is a cozy incremental packing puzzle where you scan, pack, seal, label, and ship orders while unlocking perks, automation, bigger boxes, contracts, and endless warehouse challenges.

releases.name: Black Hole Surfers
releases.summary: Black Hole Surfers is a short incremental action game about surfing the edge of a black hole while dodging asteroids, collecting resources and avoiding being dragged in yourself! Upgrade your weapons systems, shields, engines and more as you jump from sector to sector, trying to find your way home.

releases.name: Scared Numbers
releases.summary: An atmospheric puzzle where the same numbers can be both the right answer and a mistake. Select numbers on the board, complete conditions, build sums, and solve formulas with increasing complexity.

releases.name: I Only Moved My Mouse
releases.summary: Any warehouse manager would kill for a heavy-duty hero like this to move the goods. So many crates to stack, so little time. But when you happen to have a forklift with a magnetic arm, moving boxes goes a lot faster. Unfortunately, warehouses of the future can be tricky to navigate. Solve this puzzle game's secrets to load up the truck on each level. Forklifts are easy to operate...right? The packages are ready to be loaded onto the truck, all you have to do is get them there. Move your loader, pick up the boxes, and stack them on the truck to succeed in this puzzle game. It's not as easy as it sounds solve sequence codes, avoid obstacles and treat delicate packages carefully! Complete each taxing task to become the ultimate loader. The madcap machine is back with many more physics puzzles to solve. These trucks aren't gonna load themselves! Break out a can of elbow grease and start moving the crates.

releases.name: Priestess's Delusions
releases.summary: She turned my summer into a mystical tale — a delusion that melts away like snow the moment I close my eyes.

releases.name: Warehouse Chaos Simulator
releases.summary: Warehouse Chaos Simulator is a satisfying warehouse organization simulation game where you sort identical products into boxes, organize shelves by category, and unlock skills to optimize your workflow.

releases.name: Leviathan: Rhino
releases.summary: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

releases.name: Penguin Fury
releases.summary: Penguin Fury is a roguelite auto-battler. Draft penguins, merge them into stronger forms, bolt on weapons and drop them into endless waves. Chain kills to climb from FRENZY to GODLIKE, unlock 70 skins across 6 eras, and push every run one wave further.

releases.name: KESSLER: Orbital Incremental
releases.summary: 1983: a killer satellite is put into orbit, then forgotten. 2041: it wakes up, and everything circling the Earth becomes a target. One shot, a cloud of debris, a chain reaction. An incremental pixel-art game where you set off the Kessler syndrome.

releases.name: Vast Mines
releases.summary: A simple but addictive isometric mining game, get upgrades, forge pickaxes, and travel deeper into the mines.

releases.name: Hking's Block Arena
releases.summary: Up to twelve cube robots, one grid, one shot then reload. A couch-first party shooter: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, King of the Hill, Juggernaut and Gun Game - up to 8 players on one screen, online with friends over Steam, or against bots.

releases.name: AMMO DUMP
releases.summary: A first-person incremental shooter about one cube. Shoot it until it breaks and a bigger one slams down from the sky. Grab rounds from the ammo piles, chase bullseyes and gold cubes, and grow a skill tree from one pistol to lightning storms, turrets, meteors and a sun.

releases.name: Tenebrarium
releases.summary: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

releases.name: Grimoire of Blanks
releases.summary: Every spell is unfinished. The consequences aren’t. Fill the blanks with words, twist sentences into devastating combos, and survive alone or with friends in this 1–4 player roguelite deckbuilder.

releases.name: Hacker Plan
releases.summary: Are you a person who likes numbers? Having fun with addition, subtraction, multiplication or division?Then you should try Numble!It is a funny game in which you can challenge your friends or choose a challenger random.Each match consists of three rounds. In each round you have 2 minutes in which you need to find the greatest number of combinations on the board: 2 numbers (operands) + operator + 1 number (result).For each combination is assigned a score which varies according to the complexity of the combination.The winner is to score the highest score over the three rounds.Great graphics and good sound effect makes the game more captivating.E 'can play the round when you want.In addition, you can practice single game where there is the challenger.Test your math skills.Play Numble!!

releases.name: Trap Testers
releases.summary: Mr. B.w is simply REVERSI (Othello) game with cute Animation. However he has Powerful Brain.  Mr. B.W will analyze each game games about the reasons that both players win , lose, or draw. Then he will  update his strategy for Playing.So the more you play this game, the stronger COM player is.You can choose animation and COM are  ON and OFF.

releases.name: Sort Them Socks
releases.summary: A cozy sorting game. A room is buried under thousands of pairs of socks, you, and 64 empty cabinets line the walls. Match every pair by colour, pattern and price, hang it on the right rod, and watch the shelves fill up one satisfying row at a time.

releases.name: The Archive Project
releases.summary: A gothic idle card-collecting game: open packs, complete your Album, develop your city and combine cards, talents, relics, expeditions and the Monolith to build an ever-growing economy.

releases.name: Pirate Treasure: Tidy Up!
releases.summary: Attention, greenhorn! Prove you’re worthy of joining the crew by tidying up our chaotic treasure vault. Sort every piece of loot into its rightful place, upgrade your sluggish hands with hooks and peglegs, and discover hidden skills along the way!

releases.name: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store!
releases.summary: Silk Collector is a cozy organizing simulator where you shelve 4,012 scattered clothes in a magical fashion house. Shelve the clothes to collect silk, then spend it on spells that speed up the sorting. Keep an eye out for the clothes that wander the store like ghosts.

releases.name: Trivia Mayhem
releases.summary: Defend your points, steal from friends, and fool the room with a fake answer. Trivia Mayhem is a party trivia game for up to 8 players online, with local play and solo bots. Choose from thousands of questions, pick your topics, and turn up the twists.

releases.name: Rennspiel
releases.summary: Up to 16 cars on one screen and no room for manners. A top-down racer in the spirit of the 16-bit era: rockets, mines and oil on the road, eight championships, 2 to 4 players on one machine on pads or the keyboard, LAN, Steam, and an editor for tracks of your own.

releases.name: Fantasy Psychological Defense Course
releases.summary: A first-person exam simulator: pass by observing, remembering and deducing.

releases.name: Ravenford: The Last Raven Warden
releases.summary: Ravenford: The Last Raven Warden is a painterly dark fantasy beat 'em up. Fight through twelve cursed chapters as the last warden, chain sword combos and fiery spells, move between lanes, upgrade your blade and armor, and face monstrous bosses to free a land swallowed by night.

releases.name: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
releases.summary: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.

releases.name: KOLUN
releases.summary: This is a sliding/tile puzzle game especially for kids, but it can be enjoyable for the whole family!This game challenges the player to slide the pieces of an image to their original place to recreate the image. You can choose from different cars, motorbikes, airplanes and difficulty levels.** Try it for free NOW for a limited time! **Features:* Many nice car, motor, airplane, etc. pictures* 6 different difficulty levels - enjoyable for to whole family* Collect stars* Immediate restart* Change difficulty during play

releases.name: High Voltage
releases.summary: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game where you build and expand a power grid across a beautiful island. Generate electricity, connect infrastructure, earn money, unlock new technology, and grow a small local grid into a massive energy network.

releases.name: Retro TV Tycoon
releases.summary: Take charge of a 90s television network in Retro TV Tycoon! Acquire rights for sitcoms and cult movies, schedule 24-hour broadcast grids, sign high-paying commercial sponsors, upgrade your newsroom, and expand your antenna grid to dominate the planetary airwaves.

releases.name: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal
releases.summary: Your master got pulled into a crystal, so go get him back. A simple, chunky survivor roguelite where your knight swings on his own and you decide what he swings with. Blend fire, frost and lightning into every hit and fight through five biomes.

releases.name: The Peg Mines
releases.summary: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

releases.name: Jewelry Keeper
releases.summary: Try to jump as many times as you can and try not to fall down. The higher you go the more points you get. After the game is over  and your score is bigger than your highscore a pop up shows up with your new highscore. You can share your score in facebook to compete with your friends.Get the highest score amoung your friends!

releases.name: Football Manager: Auto Chess
releases.summary: A football management game mixed with collection career play. You manage a themed club, schedule training, recruitment and league fixtures, then drag coach cards to command near-realtime matches as you climb from lower leagues to bigger stages.

releases.name: Bannerborn
releases.summary: Build an unlikely army and push it to absurd extremes. Recruit troops, fuse their abilities, stack powerful upgrades, and watch your plans erupt into battle. Take on a branching fantasy expedition solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

releases.name: My Little Garden
releases.summary: My Little Garden is a cozy incremental gardening game where you plant crops, combine unique plant effects, complete contracts, and unlock powerful upgrades. Automate your garden, earn gold while you are away, and grow your humble plot into a thriving farm.

releases.name: Wireframe
releases.summary: Stem the tide of endless hordes of enemies in a new, retro styled, and fast paced arcade shooter game. Buy upgrades, and earn the highest score you can through mastery of movement, precision, and endurance.

releases.name: CatVac
releases.summary: Catvac is a cozy 3D cat-collecting adventure. Daze wild cats, vacuum them up with your Catvac 3000, and use their abilities to open new areas on your way to rescue your catnapped cat Bubba. Over fifty cats to find, casino, amusement park, and so much more to explore!

releases.name: Tactics: Setting Sun
releases.summary: Tactics: Setting Sun is a turn-based strategy game centered around the Pacific Theater of World War II. Equip and command your troops as you see fit. Features multiplayer and single-player modes, an integrated map editor, and a rogue-like campaign.

releases.name: Get It Free
releases.summary: An idle cultivation game on your desktop. Start as a street thief: auto-spot targets, steal loot, auction it. Learn chain stealing, invisibility, time-stop. Explore the Shadow Market, run an auction house and knock-off workshop, rise to the highest heavens—until anything can be stolen.

releases.name: Where Are the Brakes?
releases.summary: One shopping cart. Up to four players sharing the controls. Steer, jump and shoot through 10 hazardous stages and two boss battles in this co-op action game. Handle everything solo, or invite friends and find out whether your teamwork can survive without brakes.
